_about: Public-domain Urian Oakes (1631-1681), minister of Cambridge, Massachusetts, and president of Harvard, for the Word Hoard: New-England Pleaded With (1673), The Unconquerable, All-Conquering Souldier (1674), The Soveraign Efficacy of Divine Providence (1682) and A Seasonable Discourse (1682), from Internet Archive scans of Early English Books. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 51 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

_excluded.oakes-other: His 1650 almanac; Eikon Basilike Trite (1697, the catalogue's attribution is doubtful)
